sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager are struggling near the bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches, having lost their last five games before a single recent win. This should present Sandbach with a strong opportunity to extend their unbeaten stretch and consolidate their leadership position.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town, level on form with a draw in their most recent outing, travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides. AFC Bridgnorth, third and riding a five-game winning streak before a recent loss, face Eccleshall at home; Eccleshall are sixth but have lost their last outing and remain without a draw this season. In-form Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and on a two-game winning run, head away to Wednesfield Community, who are mid-table but inconsistent. Bilston Town, fifth and unbeaten in their last two, host Foley Meir in a clash between the upper half. New Mills, winless in their last three, host Market Drayton Town, who are similarly struggling with just one win in their last three. Crewe, near the bottom with one win in their last six, face Allscott Heath, who have won their last outing after a pair of losses. Brereton Social, mid-table and on a two-game winning streak, host Widnes Town, who sit bottom with no wins from seven matches and have lost their last three. Shawbury United, without a win in five games, host Barnton, who have climbed to seventh with a recent win after a defeat. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-from-bottom with mixed recent form, travel to Telford Town, who are level on points and struggling at the wrong end of the table.
